summary: All twelve phases of the trans-arrival substrate refactor are implemented and green. SharingSkeleton carries a fourth periodic datum for succession plus the lift obligation it creates; Thread.step reads the arrival-pruned trans relation; (C1')'s untl and snce clauses quantify over succession out of and into the time rather than over share-classes. The five declarations recording an empty L-plus certificate class for a stability modal over a tense operator were retired with their C2 baseline and theorem-index rows, the retirement documented as the intended signal of a successful repair. Four positive results replaced them: plusCertifies_stabSnce_example and plusCertifies_stabUntl_example are six-condition certificates at non-trivial sharing for Pp to stab Pp and Fp to (not p to stab Fp), and not_snce_share_congr and not_untl_shift_share_congr refute the retired congruences on those same families. A new wired evidence probe shows the lift field is a genuine obligation. Soundness did not move: plusTruth_iff_mem, plusRefutes_of_certifies and total_eq_thread are byte-identical to their pre-refactor form. lake build green over 2771 jobs, zero sorries, axiom count unchanged at 14, all gates passing.
